title: Link Building in the USA in 2026: What Actually Works
content:
Link Building in the USA: Manual, Niche-Aware, Backed by Real Publisher Data

The US is the most contested English-language market in SEO — the largest advertiser economy on earth, chasing the same pool of genuinely good publishers. Winning here takes more than volume. It takes niche-aware targeting, manual outreach, and honesty about what a real placement actually looks like. Here's what that looks like, backed by real numbers from our own publisher pool.

Why the US Market Needs a Different Approach

"The US market" isn't one thing. A finance or health placement faces tight editorial scrutiny and real legal exposure for the publisher. A general lifestyle placement sits in a much larger, more variable pool. A regional service business often gets more value from a local or industry publication than from a generic national one. We build campaigns around that fragmentation instead of ignoring it.

Niche-Aware Vetting

YMYL niches like finance and health get stricter review and slower, more careful outreach. General niches get broader targeting without cutting corners on quality.

Manual, Relationship-Based Outreach

No automated blasts. Every US publisher on our list is pitched by a real person, with a pitch that matches what that specific site actually covers.

Transparent Reporting

You see the actual site, its traffic, and its relevance to your niche before you commit — not just a Domain Rating number attached to a promise.

How It Works

  • Discovery: We learn your niche, whether it carries YMYL sensitivity, and whether national or regional publishers matter more for your business.
  • Targeted Prospecting: We match you against the relevant slice of our US publisher pool — not a one-size-fits-all list.
  • Manual Outreach: Real pitches to real editorial contacts, written around what each publisher actually covers.
  • Transparent Delivery: You see the site, the traffic, and the placement before it's finalized — no surprises after the invoice.

Frequently Asked Questions

How big is your US publisher pool?

3,000+ USA-based sites, with a median Domain Rating in the mid-50s and typical monthly traffic ranging from the low thousands to the low tens of thousands per site.

Why don't you publish the full site list?

A publisher's editorial value depends partly on scarcity. Public "vetted site" lists get hammered with pitches from every buyer who finds them, which degrades the sites and the links placed on them. We show a real, relevant sample for your niche instead.

Do you price the same across every niche?

No. Niches with tighter editorial standards and more legal exposure, like finance and health, genuinely cost more per placement than general or lifestyle niches. See our full pricing breakdown by tier here.
